scene_003: The source says the council was intended; it does not say Lamoni or Anti-Nephi-Lehi attended, only that Ammon and his party came to Ishmael to hold a council with them. Listing them as present invents attendance.
scene_005: The supplied speech at Alma 24:7–9 is spoken by the king, as Alma 24:6 identifies “their king” and Alma 24:7 introduces “the words which he said.” Labeling the speaker unidentified and prohibiting identification as king contradicts the source.
scene_006: Alma 24:10–11 continues the king’s speech, established in the immediately preceding verses. Calling the speaker unnamed and prohibiting identification by title contradicts the source and alters continuity.
scene_007: Alma 24:12–13 continues the king’s speech from the preceding verses. Calling the speaker unidentified and prohibiting identification as king contradicts the source and alters continuity.
scene_008: Alma 24:14 continues the king’s speech from the preceding verses. Although no figure or angel need be shown, the scene notes that the speaker is unidentified, contradicting continuity and the source.
scene_009: Alma 24:15–16 continues the king’s speech from the preceding verses. Calling the speaker unidentified and prohibiting identification as king contradicts the source and alters continuity.
